entities.summary: Deutsche Presse-Agentur GmbH is a German news agency founded in 1949. News is available in seven languages, among them German, English, Spanish and Arabic. German Press Agency is a news agency in Hamburg, established in 1949-08-18. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
